summary: Cheque dishonour under Section 138 Negotiable Instruments Act; burden of proof on accused to rebut presumption of legally enforceable debt; High Court erred in reappreciating evidence; concurrent findings of Trial and Appellate Courts upheld; no proof of withdrawal or business relationship by complainant insufficient to negate admitted cheque signature; appeal allowed restoring conviction and sentence.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; conviction and one-year imprisonment with Rs.35,00,000 fine restored; compensation of Rs.30,00,000 to complainant.
